referenceSource.definition: Harmonized forest according to FAO-FRA/EUDR definitions; distinct from ESA WorldCover tree cover class 10
referenceSource.method: Reuse unchanged saved publisher-rendered WMS PNGs, georeferenced from existing manifest. Clip to existing region countries; in Russia exclude entire saved ESA extent to retain its distinct 2021 tree class. No recolouring, colour extraction, class query or area calculation.
referenceSource.noData: Transparent WMS pixels do not distinguish non-forest and nodata; leave hatch and explicitly mark unclassified. No source class/nodata grid was acquired.
referenceSource.knownIssue: Producer reports overestimation in low-density Siberian tree landscapes; reference views are not accurate forest/harvest boundaries.
